To: Board of [AUTHORITY]
Re: Taxable revenue bond and PILOT for [COMPANY]'s [PROJECT], [COUNTY]

Staff recommends authorizing a taxable revenue bond of $12,245,000 par. This funds $12,000,000 of project cost after 2.0% costs of issuance, rounded up to the next $5,000. The bond carries 4.50% fixed for 20 years. Months 1-24 are interest-only at $45,918.75 per month. Months 25-240 are 216 level payments of about $82,815.95 that fully amortize par. Total interest over the term is about $6,745,295. Against [COMPANY]'s projected $1,500,000 in annual net operating income, debt service coverage during amortization is about 1.51x.

The PILOT covers $18,000,000 of real property and $9,000,000 of equipment. Equipment depreciates 10% of original cost per year, to $6,300,000 in year 3, with a floor of $1,800,000 from year 8 on. At a 40% assessment ratio, full tax is $291,276 in year 1 (27.9 mills) and $225,720 in year 8 (28.5 mills). The abatement starts at 100% in year 1 and drops 10 points a year. The year-6 PILOT payment is $123,120. Abated taxes over the ten years total $1,447,740, with a present value of about $1,210,576 at 5.0%. That is about $9,652 per job for 150 jobs averaging $52,000.

Staff recommends approval.
